requirements.title: EXTENDS_TYPE_OF has exact results for disassociated-or-unallocated unlimited arguments and extensible dynamic types
requirements.definition: The result is true when MOLD is unlimited polymorphic and is either a disassociated pointer or an unallocated allocatable variable; otherwise it is false when A is unlimited polymorphic and is either a disassociated pointer or an unallocated allocatable variable; otherwise it exactly reflects whether A's dynamic type extends MOLD's dynamic type when either dynamic type is extensible.

pending.extends-type-of-unlimited-mold-disassoci: Use two MOLD controls with allocated nondefault A: CLASS(*), POINTER :: mold_ptr => NULL() and unallocated CLASS(*), ALLOCATABLE :: mold_alloc; assert EXTENDS_TYPE_OF(A,mold_ptr) and EXTENDS_TYPE_OF(A,mold_alloc) are true, then mutate by allocating each MOLD to a sibling type so the disassociated/unallocated branch is load-bearing.
pending.extends-type-of-unlimited-a-disassociate: Use two A controls with allocated extensible MOLD: CLASS(*), POINTER :: a_ptr => NULL() and unallocated CLASS(*), ALLOCATABLE :: a_alloc; assert EXTENDS_TYPE_OF(a_ptr,MOLD) and EXTENDS_TYPE_OF(a_alloc,MOLD) are false after separate MOLD disassociated/unallocated true controls prove the branch order.
pending.extends-type-of-extension-relation-true-: Use parent/child/grandchild/sibling objects and assert child-parent and grandchild-parent true, parent-child and sibling-child false; swap call order as a required mutation.
